tool.name: FeatureFinderLFQ
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && mkdir out && #if "out_tsv_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_tsv && #end if #if "out_hills_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir out_hills && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' #if "out_tsv_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_tsv 'out_tsv/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if "out_hills_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -out_hills 'out_hills/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' #end if #if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' '$out' #if "out_tsv_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_tsv/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_tsv' #end if #if "out_hills_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'out_hills/output.${gxy2omsext("tabular")}' '$out_hills' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input mzML file (centroided data)
Force writing of hills file even if no output path was provided
Minimum intensity threshold
Minimum m/z value
Maximum m/z value
Mass accuracy in ppm for combining peaks into hills
Mass accuracy in ppm for isotopic patterns
Hill valley factor for splitting hills
Isotope valley factor for splitting isotope patterns
Minimum number of scans for a hill
Minimum combined intensity for PASEF/TIMS clusters after m/z–ion-mobility centroiding
Minimum number of raw points per PASEF/TIMS cluster during centroiding
Minimum charge state
Maximum charge state
Number of isotopes for intensity calculation (0=mono only, -1=all, 1=mono+first, etc.)
Negative mode (affects neutral mass calculation)
Enable TOF-specific intensity filtering
Enable profile mode processing (centroid spectra using PeakPickerHiRes)
Ion mobility accuracy for linking peaks into hills and grouping isotopes (0 = disable IM-based gating)
param.help: Default is for 1/K0 units (e.g., 0.03-0.08). For CCS data, use larger values (e.g., 5-20 square angstroms)

param.label: Enable automatic hill mass tolerance calibration
Disable automatic isotope mass error calibration
Maximum allowed RT difference (in seconds) between monoisotopic hill apex and isotope hill apex when assembling isotope patterns (0 disables RT gating)
Representation of feature convex hulls in the output FeatureMap
param.help: 'bounding_box' stores a single RT–m/z bounding box per feature (smaller featureXML, no per-trace detail), whereas 'mass_traces' stores one convex hull per contributing hill using all mass-trace points (larger featureXML, preserves detailed trace shape)

param.label: For FAIMS data with multiple compensation voltages: Merge features representing the same analyte detected at different CV values into a single feature
param.help: Only features with DIFFERENT FAIMS CV values are merged (same CV = different analytes). Has no effect on non-FAIMS data

param.label: Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs
param.option: out_hills (Optional: write detected hills to TSV)

data.name: out_tsv
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_tsv
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_tsv_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: out_hills
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: out_hills
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "out_hills_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Feature detection for LC-MS1 data (EXPERIMENTAL)
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_FeatureFinderLFQ.html
